name: ci-smoke
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2]
    steps:
      - run: pytest -q --shard-id=${{ matrix.shard }} --num-shards=2
